description: An elegant wedding invitation stationery set displayed on a wooden surface with a lace runner. The set features a palette of deep emerald green, ivory/cream, and gold foil accents, including an open keepsake box with pull-out drawer, matching cards, envelopes with wax seals, an acrylic plaque, loose white rose blossoms, and a pearl necklace.

key_details.design_elements: Gold foil floral illustrations, embossed wax seals, calligraphy lettering, gold borders
key_details.presentation_box: Two-tier cream box with top compartment and lower drawer with gold knob
key_details.acrylic_element: Clear acrylic standing invitation engraved with white floral border and script
key_details.decorative_props: White roses, rose petals, pearl necklace, lace table runner
